change.title: pr-94942
change.author: Sam Jewell

findings.title: enableSqlExpressions always returns false, so SQL expressions can never be read
findings.body: `enabled := !IsEnabledGlobally(...)` is inverted. When the flag is on, `enabled` is false and the function falls through to `return false`. When the flag is off, `enabled` is true and the function returns false. Both paths return false. `ReadQuery` at line 129 therefore always returns "sqlExpressions is not implemented", even with the flag on. The function should be `return h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)`. If the feature is meant to be disabled outright, a hard-coded error is clearer than this dead logic.

findings.title: DB stub returns "not implemented" for every method, which breaks SQL expressions and table parsing
findings.body: All three methods return errors. `TablesList` in parser.go:22 calls `RunCommands`, so it always fails. `SQLCommand.Execute` (sql_command.go:100) always fails through `QueryFramesInto`. Together with the reader gate, the feature is removed rather than gated. `NewSQLCommand` in sql_command.go:30 calls `sql.TablesList`, so building a SQL command also fails. The PR title and body in pr.json were not re-read to check this is intended. If removal is intended, say so explicitly and drop the dead code. Otherwise the dependency removal cannot go in without a replacement implementation.

findings.title: Parser tests are skipped, so the stub behaviour has no coverage
findings.body: parser_test.go skips TestParse and TestParseWithComma with `t.Skip()`. Nothing tests that the stubbed path returns the expected error or that the reader gate works. A small test of `ReadQuery` with the flag on and off would have caught the inverted flag.

contracts.equivalent_path: Other query types in ReadQuery parse the query without a gate
contracts.before_after: Before, the SQL query was parsed and executed with go-duck. Now enableSqlExpressions always returns false, so ReadQuery returns an error before parsing.
contracts.visible_effect: Users get a 'sqlExpressions is not implemented' error, even with the feature flag on.
contracts.failure_mode: The error is explicit, but it contradicts the flag.

contracts.action: Execute SQLCommand through the stub DB
contracts.before_after: Before, the query ran in DuckDB. Now the stub returns 'not implemented'.
contracts.failure_mode: The error is logged and set on rsp.Error.

summary: The PR removes go-duck and stubs the SQL DB. The new `enableSqlExpressions` helper has an inverted check and always returns false, so SQL expressions are rejected even with the flag on. The stubbed DB methods also always return errors. The go.mod and go.sum changes follow from the dependency removal. I did not re-read pr.json to confirm that removing the feature is intended.
